title: Reconcile the current base and author the remaining independence execution queue

costar.context: Owner requests an executable plan over existing work, with no capability loss or additional product implementation in this pass.
costar.objective: Refresh the single roadmap and bind every historical review to a concrete execution boundary and acceptance evidence.
costar.response: Committed planning artifacts; unresolved origin and parity stay open.

concerns: All 3193 history reviews were only planned; source coverage must not be reported as behavioral absorption.
The test_mode license fixture can hide feature loss in the shipped configuration.
Existing own organisations/OIDC/SCIM/recovery cover narrower workflows than some older feature contracts.
Renaming or further modifying inherited implementation is not evidence that its license obligations disappear. Retain notices and resolve actual origins.
A source-format/API break does not permit dropping standard protocols, quotas, isolation, durability or recovery.
This pass authors planning and audit artifacts only; it must not silently change product code or mark release rows Done.
context: Audit anchor 19c4409e97a89ab1c40716dab49ed9ee59d5dd32; current candidate build and Check succeeded; release unchanged.
current_state: Existing Svelte/Rust feature ports and history ledger exist. Five newer commits are absent from the old roadmap snapshot; remaining feature initialization and private application dispatch are still coupled to old paths.
target_design: One refreshed ROADMAP, existing D1-D11 map extended with owner claim/external feeds/source closure, and an execution queue binding all history reviews to reuse, required delta and behavior proof.
changes: Refresh ROADMAP status and name current execution order.
Add bounded execution cards and a refreshed complete Git/history comparison snapshot.
Correct stale pending-work statements and distinguish historical release evidence from current packaged proof.
Author owner-claim behavior and failed/retried/repeated claim tests without implementing it.
boundaries: No product source, dependency, release version, tag or channel changes.
No new UI rewrite, legacy API compatibility layer, waiver request or blanket history merge.
PostgreSQL first; FoundationDB scale and existing storage versatility remain.

verification.name: History and queue completeness
verification.command: Compare all stored commits, 53 source heads plus current main, every history review row and every assigned task ID
verification.proves: No available historical source/review omitted; no false absorption claim
verification.expected: 257 stored commits covered; 3193 reviews assigned; unique valid task IDs
verification.result: Passed Python assertions over git rev-list/cat-file and CSV records: 257/257 audited stored commits covered by 53 historical source heads plus current main; zero uncovered; 3193/3193 original reviews preserved and assigned to 17 valid unique cards. All 53 historical source commits resolve. All semantic dispositions remain open.

verification.name: Whole planning consistency
verification.command: python .ai/machine/organize.py --check; validate artifact paths and queue dependencies; git diff --check; inspect changed-path allowlist
verification.proves: Plans are schema valid, links/dependencies resolve and product/release files were not changed
verification.expected: All checks pass; only explicitly named planning documents and audit data change
verification.result: Passed path existence, required card fields, dependency graph, review identifier/original-field preservation and changed-path allowlist assertions. .ai/machine/organize.py --check passed (6 modules, 58 documents); git diff --check passed. Product source/Cargo/release tags unchanged. Planning deliverable complete; implementation status remains draft because product cuts are not executed.
